description: packages/core/src/job-queue: LeaseRef.tenantId and claim opts.tenantId were optional. owned() checked the tenant only when defined, and claim() filtered by tenant only when given, so a heartbeat/complete/fail/claim that omitted tenantId matched ANY tenant's job. Contract t050-job-queue criterion 13 documented it ('production callers must pass it') but nothing enforced it. Caller audit: the only non-test caller is pipeline-runner.ts (6 queue calls: 1 claim + 1 heartbeat + 3 fail + 1 complete, all pass tenantId); pipeline-runner and job-queue are not imported by apps/api, scripts/ or any worker (workers/transcribe/src/job_queue.py is an unrelated Mongo-backed Python queue bound to a tenant at construction). No contract or decision gives an omitted tenant an 'all tenants' or 'operator' meaning.
repro: q.enqueue({id:'a',tenantId:'ta',payload:1}); j=q.claim('w1',{tenantId:'ta'}).value; q.complete({id:'a',workerId:'w1',attempt:j.attempt}) -> ok (before the fix); q.claim('w') with no tenant returned ta's job (before the fix)
fix_direction: tenantId REQUIRED in LeaseRef and claim opts (type), runtime refuses a missing/empty/malformed tenant with typed invalid-input, owned() always compares the tenant. Done in lane/jobqtenant. Contract criterion 13 text ('may carry', 'Without it behaviour is as in invariants 3 and 6') is now stale and needs a checker update (maker may not edit qa/contracts).
